To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the concurrent and relay hybridizations of the multiobjective optimizer SMS‐EMOA with local search methods are able to improve the convergence to Pareto front solutions in continuous multiobjective solution spaces.
the hybridization of the evolutionary algorithm SMS-EMOA with local search methods improves convergence and accuracy of the solutions found in the Pareto front.

The relay hybridization of SMSEMOA and local methods like Hooke and Jeeves and Newton is able to improve the convergence of SMS-EMEA in terms of convergence speed and solution accuracy on a wide variety of test problems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question how to efficiently combine the advantages of two different optimization methods.
the question of whether the idea of hybridization can be successfully transferred to continuous multiobjective optimization.
the development and analysis of new hybridization strategies for continuous multiobjective evolutionary algorithms and the improvement of their performance.
